doc.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025

title: Closing: the book and upcoming gigs
summary: Levy names his book I Speak Music, mentions upcoming plans including the Howard Levy Four, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’ve come a long way since spending $2.25 on your first harmonica.
I hope so yeah. They’re much more expensive, that’s how long –
I’ve really enjoyed this conversation, Howard, and wish you the best with your book.
Thanks. And the name of the book, I forgot to say what the name of the book is, what is it – oh it’s called I Speak Music, Stories from my Improbable Life. That’s what it’s called.
Titles are not always easy things, but that’s a good one.

Yeah. And it’s available online on Amazon and eventually on many more platforms. Yeah. It’s been an interesting time the last few years doing these major projects interspersed with intense tours and live gigs and also with my own band. We might be coming to the Rochester Jazz Festival too, the Howard Levy Four.
Oh good. I’ll definitely be there for that.
I’ll just pause our recording and we’ll say our good-byes.
